name: @serve-tools/client-shared-websocket
description: SharedWorker-coordinated typed WebSocket requests and subscriptions
author: Jonathan Neal <jonathantneal@hotmail.com> (https://jonneal.dev)

scripts.benchmark: npm run build:dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.benchmark.config.ts
scripts.build:dependencies: npm run build:dependencies --workspace @serve-tools/client-websocket && npm run build --workspace @serve-tools/client-messaging --workspace @serve-tools/client-websocket
scripts.test: npm run build:dependencies && npm run test:node && npm run test:browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:dependencies && npm run build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
